name: Knowing Your Destiny
overview: Scripture reveals that knowing your destiny is rooted in trusting the Lord as your shepherd who provides and guides (Psalms 23:1). God’s plans for His people are filled with hope and a promised future, not harm, assuring believers of an expected end shaped by His peace (Jeremiah 29:11). Central to this destiny is Jesus Christ, the eternal Word who is God, through whom salvation and eternal life are granted to all who believe (John 1:1; John 3:16). Jesus declares Himself as the only way to the Father, emphasizing that coming to Him secures acceptance and the fulfillment of God’s purpose for life (John 6:37; John 14:6).
